title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as rising oil, Treasury yields lift Fed hike bets - The Economic Times
text:
US stocks fell as Brent crude surged 6% to $107 a barrel and Treasury yields climbed to multi-year highs. Rising energy prices and producer inflation data strengthened expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next week. Nvidia and Micron declined, while Apple gained after launching its latest iPhone.
